note: Pilot: Spacing: the travel time between patches, 3, 6 and 9 s, on a Gaussian at Gini 0.5 that is stretched 2:1 along shape (S1), 1:2 (S2, S1 turned and reflected: the same interaction 0.09 and nonlinearity 0.40) or round (S3), centred at (0.712, 0.712), (0.288, 0.712) and (0.578, 0.21), so each session needs fresh learning. The gains are set so that the learner earns the same points in each session (the S1 gain 1.2545 is the calibrated one, 1128 learner points; the others are that gain scaled by the ratio of the learner's points at that common gain on the 40 check worlds, 1058 and 937 points: 1.3375 and 1.5113; docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-25), and are higher for the longer-travel sessions; S2 and S3 are longer (200 and 220 s) so that the number of bushes harvested falls less with travel. The participants are not told what varies. The world seeds are those of the earlier round-map design (not searched again for these maps).
